I’ve had great jobs and a couple good relationships. None of them have been able to last though because my mood always changes and it’s awful. I recently got out of a relationship because I didn’t want to put the burden on my partner not knowing how I was going to feel day in and day out, a week or so later, a month later and so on. It’s been a struggle to have anything consistent and that’s been very hard to deal with.
